tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a public URL that captures any HTTP request sent to it. Use it when you need something outside this session to reach you: an OAuth redirect, a payment provider callback, a CI notification, a webhook you are testing. Returns the URL to hand to the other service. Requests are readable with get_requests or wait_for_request.

label.description: Optional note to yourself, for example 'stripe test'.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes you currently own, with their URLs and expiry.

tools.name: wait_for_request
tools.description: Block until a request lands in the inbox, then return it. This is the tool to use straight after you have triggered the action that should produce the callback. Returns immediately if something already arrived after the sequence number you pass.

after_seq.description: Return only requests newer than this sequence number. Use 0 the first time.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait. Capped by your tier.

tools.name: get_requests
tools.description: List what has arrived in an inbox, newest last. Returns summaries without bodies. Use get_request for the full contents of one.

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Return the full method, headers, query string and body of a single captured request. Text bodies come back as text, binary as base64.

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Delete an inbox and everything captured in it.
